subject: Mobile Development
title: Haptic Feedback and Touch Simulation
description: A quick, practical guide to Haptic Feedback and Touch Simulation.

hook.text: Your phone can simulate the feeling of clicking a button on a flat glass screen. That's haptics.

buildup.text: Taptic engines create precise vibrations that mimic physical sensations — clicks, textures, and taps.

discovery.text: Advanced haptics could let you feel fabric textures in a shopping app or resistance in a game.

twist.text: Ultrasonic haptics — vibrating air above the screen — could create touch sensations without contact.

climax.text: Haptics add the sense of touch to the digital world, making screens feel physical.

punchline.text: Flat glass that feels like real buttons and textures.

quiz.question: What do haptic engines do?
options: Create precise vibrations that simulate physical sensations
